insertion: At evidence register 3, [the Prisoner whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-account-answerability) **figures** the Encounter–Region–Name–Count–Countenance–Account circuit through a captured arrival into a world whose names and counts are already operative. Number Six is publicly recognisable within that region, yet recognition can make his reply into the administration's account of him. The opening source-question and the election test whether Count-to-Account can return to an encounter able to change the region's terms. The operation keeps all six terms distinct and asserts no shared lexical ancestry with the programme's language.

[the complete Permanence in Change whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/german-literature/goethe-permanence-change/WHOLE.md#goethe-two-ones-return) **qualifies** its own homology by keeping the whole poem in view. Blossom and foliage pass; fruit ripens beside germination; river, perceiving eyes and bodily capacities change; the name endures while its bearer is figured as a wave. Only after these losses does the final stanza gather beginning and end through the Muses' promise of imperishable content and form. The appointed relation to the two Ones preserves those differences instead of extracting an unchanged personal substance from the poem. The forty-line German sequence is the collated witness; Nims's English wording remains uncollated, and neither poetic term is a literal identity for native `0` or `1`.

At evidence register 3, [the Job whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-measure-trust-return) **figures** the circuit from disclosure through account and trust to a changed source-field. The friends' account of suffering affects their next encounter by deepening the isolation it then interprets; Job's intercession changes the relation from which a further account can begin. Thus source-answerability, reliance, consequence and re-entry each do work in E4's four operations. Trust preserves the possibility of revision without imposing continued exposure to harm, and the comparison asserts no common lexical descent.

At evidence register 3, [the Prisoner whole](../../../mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-account-answerability) **figures** an account that arranges its next encounter: election publicity produces Six's public identity and the result confers an office without effective freedom. Disclosure, accounting and reliance consequently require a return to the conditions under which the representation acts. E4's fourth operation becomes decisive where contrary encounter must be allowed to revise those conditions. The example retains the field's three terms and four operations without making institutional efficacy a certificate of trust.
